Missing construction, not a constructor idiom: Rails builds and includes the module lazily — `@generated_attribute_methods ||= Module.new.tap { |mod| include mod }` (activemodel/lib/active_model/attribute_methods.rb:400-402). The port (attribute-methods.ts:467-469) is `return this._generatedMethods`, so neither the construction nor the include happens here.
